brief: Shapewear, loungewear and underwear, inclusive sizing XXS-5X. Mostly women 22-40 who buy on drops. Don't send us people who only shop discount.

config.advertiser_summary: Shapewear, loungewear, and underwear brand featuring inclusive sizing (XXS-5X), targeting women aged 22-40 who purchase during drop releases and are not discount-driven shoppers.

assumptions: Price not given; assumed $60 for a 'unknown' product.
Margin not given; assumed 60% (typical for apparel) for the break-even estimate only.
Break-even per customer (guidance, not enforced): $60 x 60% x 1.3 orders = $46.80.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click: verifiable without trusting a pixel. Maximise conversions within the budget: bids move between $0.25 and the $1.80 cap (category default) to spend it well; no CPA target is invented. Guidance: at the assumed margin, a click is worth about $0.94; bidding above that loses money per customer. Set a target CPA or a lower max CPC to enforce it.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
